capability.description: Calls RandomUser.me's fixed API endpoint with a results count (default 2). HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Synthetic test/demo profile generation; not real-person lookup, identity verification, or production user provisioning.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional results count (default 2); output: JSON envelope containing http_status and generated synthetic user profiles or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional results-count string; wrapper default is 2
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://randomuser.me/api/ with results=<count>; no seed, nationality, gender, pagination, or field filtering exposed
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
generated profiles are provider data and wrapper does not locally truncate or validate them
no auth, cache, or retry; output is intentionally non-deterministic and external network/rate limits apply

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing RandomUser.me synthetic profiles and info metadata, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: generate fake user profiles for testing
negative_intents: find or identify a real person
create production accounts or verify identity

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing RandomUser.me synthetic profiles and info metadata, URL, and HTTP status.
